about_blocks.text: Services Offered at Cedars at Cobble Hill
about_blocks.html: Services Offered at Cedars at Cobble Hill

about_blocks.text: Cedars at Cobble Hill specializes in treating individuals suffering from alcohol and drug addiction, eating disorders, sex addiction, and gambling addiction. The team at Cedars has extensive experience in treating addictions and provides medical detoxification, residential therapy, outpatient programs, and continuing care. Their treatment programs are gender-specific and customized to meet client’s specific needs, ensuring that each individual receives the best possible care. Cedars at Cobble Hill utilizes a holistic approach that incorporates various evidence-based therapies and complementary therapies, including 12-step facilitation, motivational interviewing, and art therapy. The length of stay at Cedars is tailored to the client’s goals, and upon completion, continuing care is provided to ensure long-term success.

about_blocks.text: The environment at Cedars at Cobble Hill is tranquil and allows clients to enjoy the beauty of nature. The facility is set on 65 acres with breathtaking views of the forest that surrounds it. The facility is modern and built to have a log-cabin style to add elegance to the house renovations. The architecture brings in a natural element that enhances the space and inspires tranquility. Clients can make use of the natural splendor of the British Columbia West coast for meditation, relaxation, and taking long walks in the woods. Clients have access to numerous outdoor trails which are surrounded by trees, providing a serene setting that facilitates healing and recovery.

about_blocks.text: Cedars at Cobble Hill provides patients with a comfortable and safe environment. The facility is designed based on the principles of Feng Shui, which promotes the importance of natural flow art and quality balance. The facility has gender-specific housing options that provide privacy and a sense of community for clients. The log cabin-style residences have exposed beams, hardwood floors, and river-rock fireplaces, which add to the natural beauty of the environment. The on-site gym and yoga studio help clients take care of their physical health during their treatment. Upon completion of treatment, clients have the option to extend their stay through the continuing care program, which provides ongoing support and guidance.

about_blocks.text: Cedars at Cobble Hill - Center Overview
about_blocks.html: Cedars at Cobble Hill - Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Cedars at Cobble Hill is a specialized rehab center dedicated to treating addiction disorders. The team understands that each patient is unique and deserves a personalized treatment plan. To achieve this goal, thorough assessments are performed throughout the treatment process to ensure the patient is responding positively to the treatment. Cedars’ programs are always invitational, never confrontational, and they do not use a one-size-fits-all approach. Instead, the clinical and support staff will encourage and guide each patient towards their full recovery, which will enable them to improve their self-esteem, develop fulfilling relationships, and accomplish individual goals.

about_blocks.text: The center’s gender-specific residences were designed to provide a private and safe environment for patients during their addiction treatment journey. Although co-ed integration is important in several stages of the program, Cedars at Cobble Hill offers gender-specific housing and women’s group activities to foster a safe and harmonious environment for each patient. Through this gender-specific approach, patients can experience open and accepting group dynamics that eliminate external distractions and provide comfort. Along with an inviting atmosphere, the center offers a range of amenities and holistic therapies, including evidence-based practices, yoga, and meditation, individual and group therapy, family counseling, and art and nature therapy to help patients achieve sustainable recovery.
